scope: Local read-only revision review of24 response and9 original Pi request cases and fixed Pi types/adapter source. No candidate implementation, HTTP execution, real provider calls, credentials or input edits.

findings.issue: 完整 Pi message/usage 映射尚未固定，现 input=prompt_tokens 在有缓存时与固定 Pi 语义不同。
findings.evidence: contract.md 仅固定 input/output/totalTokens；15 expected 没有完整 AssistantMessage。Pi types.ts 要求 api/provider/model/timestamp/cacheRead/cacheWrite/cost；openai-completions.ts:1518-1544 从 prompt_tokens 扣缓存并保留 reasoning 子集。
findings.counterexample: 代理 prompt_tokens=11,cached_tokens=4；若 input=11 且 cacheRead=4，会与原Pi记账口径矛盾。全部15样本都无cache细分，缺responseId/rawStopReason也能通过现预期。
findings.minimal_repair: 先固定完整 normalized message 输出、responseId/rawStopReason/wire ref 的关联；补一份含cached/reasoning的正常预期。成本未知不能称真实0费用，若Pi必须数值占位则另显式unknown/未计价。保留原usage和原wire，不引入新Session事实。
findings.closure: All 7 accepted response expectations now bind complete Pi AssistantMessage, original id/model/created/finish/content, complete original wire usage, cache subtraction and reasoning subset, required numeric cost placeholders plus pricing.UNKNOWN. PW16 independently carries prompt11, completion7, cacheRead4, cacheWrite2, reasoning3 => input5, output7, total18. PW24 rejects cache12>prompt11. Compared fixed Pi types.ts:383-449 and openai-completions.ts:1518-1544.

findings.issue: 只有响应样本，没有 S 第2步要求的实际请求编码正/负对照，且有限messages/过深缺明确数值。
findings.evidence: cases.json 15项均只有 response/expected；contract.md 声称本地HTTP记录请求以及原Pi toolResult转换，却未预先给 input→expected request bytes/结构和关联。
findings.counterexample: 实现遗漏上一轮 toolResult 或改 tool_call_id，只要服务照给固定15回复，所有响应转换仍可通过；默收容器URL或增大max_completion_tokens也不在这些预期内。
findings.minimal_repair: 补一个文本请求及一个 assistant toolCall→原toolResult→下一请求的完整有序样本，核 tool_call_id/Unicode原反馈/工具schema/固定模型/n/stream/预算。选择一个错关联/越权字段负控，独立HTTP记录请求数应为0；只测这一薄映射入口，不重做Runtime授权全套。固定深度/请求字节或messages上界，并预注册边界拒绝，避免实现后自定。
findings.closure: 9 original Pi request cases now specify3 exact wire byte fixtures and6 zero-HTTP refusals. PQ02 preserves original assistant ID call-feedback-1, arguments, original tool feedback Unicode and newline bytes, and message order. PQ03/04/05/06 reject mismatched tool feedback, untrusted URL,2049 completion budget and changed reserved response ID. PQ07 is65 messages. Independently measured PQ08 encoded65536 bytes and reconstructed PQ09 encoded65537 bytes. All three fixture hashes and schema/control fields match.

findings.issue: 结束语义与native动作完整性的少量关键反例未进入先行样本。
findings.evidence: PW04/05覆盖length，PW09仅缺finish；contract声明content_filter/error/未知均无成功，但没有相应样本，也未定stop+tool_calls等矛盾结构和refusal。
findings.counterexample: 未知finish默认stop、content_filter默认stop，或stop同时带native tool但被忽略，可通过15样本；同tool ID重复/arguments不是对象也未被这些样本排除。
findings.minimal_repair: 补content_filter及未知finish的原样本并固定错误输出/0 final；明确stop+native tool矛盾时拒绝或保留非终结状态，绝不完结或执行；完整原tool ID唯一、参数必须对象，给针对性负控。非空refusal可在本有限profile明确保留原件并拒绝成功，无需新增产品拒绝业务状态。
findings.closure: PW17/18 explicitly reject content_filter/unknown finish; PW19 stop with native tools, PW20 duplicate call IDs, PW21 nonobject args, PW22 refusal and PW23 depth33 now reject. Original length/native/code-fence samples remain; no action/final success follows from text or truncated output. These are specimen design checks, not runtime successes.
